notes: Rule 50 heads the existential unit on not rather than on the supplied there.
הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה writes one determiner, This, which the demonstrative takes; both articles are unrepresented (rules 41, 47).
Each coordinated rectum of יוֹם צָרָה וְתוֹכֵחָה וּנְאָצָה takes the of standing before its own word (rule 19).
